title: Classroom Locations and Lecture Halls
content:
Classrooms at CampusAI University are located across three main building blocks:
- Block A (CSE & IT departments): Classrooms 101 to 110 (1st floor), Classrooms 201 to 210 (2nd floor), and Classrooms 301 to 310 (3rd floor).
- Block B (ECE department): Classrooms 101 to 105 (1st floor), Classrooms 201 to 205 (2nd floor).
- Block C (ME & Sciences): Classrooms 101 to 108 (1st floor), Classrooms 201 to 208 (2nd floor).
All classrooms are equipped with smart boards, high-speed Wi-Fi, and air conditioning. Standard class hours are from 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM.

title: Laboratory Locations and Access Hours
content:
CampusAI University hosts several state-of-the-art laboratories for hands-on learning:
- Computer Lab 1 (Programming & DS): Block A, Room 401. Open Mon-Fri 8:30 AM to 8:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
- Computer Lab 2 (AI & ML): Block A, Room 405. Open Mon-Fri 8:30 AM to 8:00 PM.
- Electronics & VLSI Lab: Block B, Room 301. Open Mon-Fri 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
- IoT & Robotics Lab: Block B, Room 305. Open Mon-Fri 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
- Mechanical Workshop: Block C, Ground Floor. Open Mon-Fri 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
Students must carry their lab coats and ID cards to enter practical labs.

title: Auditoriums and Seminar Halls
content:
For academic events, guest lectures, and cultural activities, the campus has the following spaces:
- Main Auditorium (Seating capacity: 1000): Located in the Central Block, Ground Floor. Used for major events and university functions.
- Seminar Hall 1 (Seating capacity: 200): Located in Block A, 4th Floor. Used for CSE/IT workshops and student seminars.
- Seminar Hall 2 (Seating capacity: 150): Located in Block B, 3rd Floor. Used for ECE guest lectures.
- Board Room (Seating capacity: 50): Located in the Administrative Block, 2nd Floor. Used for official faculty meetings.
Booking of these spaces must be done 3 days in advance via the Admin Office.

title: Administrative Offices and Student Help Desks
content:
Administrative offices handle student documentation, fees, scholarships, and academic records:
- Registrar's Office: Administrative Block, Ground Floor. Timings: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM. Ext: 101.
- Dean of Student Affairs: Administrative Block, 1st Floor. Timings: 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM. Ext: 102.
- Accounts & Fee Section: Administrative Block, Ground Floor. Timings: 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM. Ext: 103.
- Academic Section (Grade sheets, transcripts): Administrative Block, 1st Floor. Timings: 10:00 AM - 4:30 PM. Ext: 104.
- Health Center: Central Block, Ground Floor. Open 24/7 for medical emergencies. Ext: 911.
